title: Ɔsoro Nsɛnkyerɛnne Bi Sohwɛfo
intro: Wɔ kronkronbea kronkron bi mu tɔnn no, wɔtetee ɔkra a wɔahyira no wɔ ɔsoro hwɛ ase. Na wɔahyɛ sɛ saa onipa yi bedi dwuma titiriw bi wɔ anwonwade bi mu, na wabɛyɛ adanse a ɛkyerɛ sɛ Allah tumi ne ne nyansa a enni ano. Wɔn akwantu no daa nokware bi a emu dɔ adi, na ɛkaa nsusuwii ahorow na ɛde sɛnkyerɛnne soronko bi sii hɔ maa adesamma nyinaa.
clues: Allah yii me na ote me ho sene me mmere mu mmaa nyinaa.
Wɔde me hyɛɛ odiyifo trenee bi hwɛ ase, na onyaa aduan a wɔde mae anwonwakwan so wɔ me mpaebɔ dan mu.
Mede me ho firii m’abusua ho kɔɔ kokoam baabi a mɛsom Allah.
Ɔbɔfo bi yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ me a ɔte sɛ onipa a ɔyɛ pɛ, de ɔba kronn ho asɛm brɛɛ me, ɛwom sɛ na minnim ɔbarima biara de.
Wɔ awo mu yaw akyi no, wɔhyɛɛ me sɛ menwosow mmɛ dua bi dua na menya aduan foforo.
Bere a mesan kɔɔ me nkurɔfo a wɔsoa me ba a wɔawo no foforo no nkyɛn no, wobisabisaa me nsɛm, nanso me babarima akokoaa no nam anwonwakwan so kasa fii akokoaa no so de yii me ano.

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds. (3:42)
